posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked: They do look like a lot of fun.  Mainstay looks like straight up crunchy goodness, but vastly more powerful if someone can slap some damage mitigation on him.  Doctor Medico's vanilla version is indeed primarily a healer, though he doesn't heal himself all that well, so damage mitigation is extra-nice on him as well.  Malpractice Medico looks as nuts as advertised; him plus Argent Adept looks like an amazing duo.  Idealist looks fun but vulnerable to ongoing destruction; not sure how her dark id thing is going to work out in practice, it looks very swingy depending on how quickly you can get rid of it; her Super Sentai variant looks the more tempting of the two in large part because of that.  I don't understand how Cosmic Inventor Writhe works at all; Christopher said he works just fine, but to me he looks like a variant of the Naturalist that has only one form, has no way of pulling it out of his deck, and benefits from destroying it.

posts.name: Natediggadoggity
posts.cooked: On looking through writhe's cards, it looks like there are 4 one shots (2 cards, 2 copies of each) that can pull his projector directly from his deck, 3 cards (1 card, 3 copies of it) that can pull equipment from his trash, and an equipment that lets you mill the top 3 cards of your deck as a power. He also has lots of other card draw, and most of the things that destroy your shadow cloak give you a choice. Either you destroy it and do more, or you don't destroy and do a little less damage, but you're still doing things. I'm trying to puzzle through these decks myself, and see if I can figure out the best way to nuke with each of them. Not sure if I'll manage it without cards in front of me though.

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
I was wondering that myself.  Surprised no one watching it live asked that.  As written, yeah, you'd do neither.  Otherwise it would be "destroy the concept in play with the fewest cards under it."

Benchmark (previewed today) and Mainstay have a really fun counter to "Leo's Trap."  Give Benchmark the card that lets him preemptively destroy any enemy with 2 HP or less that attacks him and the card that lets you redirect any enemy damage from the hero with the lowest HP to him.  Then make sure Mainstay has the lowest HP and have him use the card that makes every enemy attack him. Boom.

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
I'm really eager to take a look at all these cards myself. Here's my first impressions:

Medico looks really cool, and it's nice to have a designated healer deck. His own health is gonna yo-yo I'm sure, even more-so than all the other VG. Malpractice is gonna make him a freaking monster...

Mainstay seems cool, lots of DR and such, but he's the one I remember the least about. Yeah, any kind of damage increase on him is gonna make him a melee BEAST. I don't remember what his promo does, unfortunatly.

Idealist looks fun, though that one bad ongoing she has is gonna make things bothersome. Gonna have to find ways to tip-toe around that when I don't want the damage boost. Sentai Idealist is gonna be crazy if she gets a good number of cards under her.

Writhe looks like he's gonna be the most interesting out of the four VG to me, but he's gonna have a bad time againt anyone who can take away his cloak. Still, he's the one I'm most eager to test out. I'm interested to see how this promo balances things out, especially since it looks like alot of his better effects require the destruction of the Shadow Cloak but his cosmic inventor variant will lose the power to grab it...
